entities.summary: Shahid Ali Khan is a retired field hockey goalkeeper from Pakistan, who won the gold medal with the Men's National Team at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. Eight years later, at the 1992 Olympics, in Barcelona, Spain, he won a bronze medal for his country. He later became the Pakistan's goalkeeping coach.
